items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 3:41 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor and statements about National Indigenous History Month, National Indigenous Peoples Day on June 21, 2025 and Pride Month.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Recess
notes: The Special Council meeting then recessed at 3:41 p.m. and reconvened at 6:27 p.m., chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic, with all members present.

items.title: To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for June 16, 2025.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 6:28 p.m.

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider two potential land disposition matters as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (c) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."

motions.text: "That the Chief Administrative Officer be authorized to approve and execute the necessary agreement(s) contemplated in Corporate Services Department report COR-2025-287 in relation to the leased building located at 57 Jubilee Drive, Kitchener, and in accordance with the terms and conditions discussed at the June 16, 2025, in-camera meeting of Council, with such agreement(s) being to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor."
